primary_source_comparison.comparison: ONDA uses reconciliation to collect a host tree, but remounts each frame, so React identity and state preservation are intentionally not an output-time contract.
primary_source_comparison.lesson: Specify evaluation purity and retained-state policy explicitly.

primary_source_comparison.comparison: ONDA has several implicit levels, but most high-level semantics disappear during direct lowering rather than remaining in explicitly typed intermediate levels.
primary_source_comparison.lesson: Use staged, inspectable lowering and record semantic loss.

primary_source_comparison.comparison: ONDA export is mostly batch-oriented while GStreamer exposes pipeline direction, element boundaries, messages and clock ownership.
primary_source_comparison.lesson: Make media flow, clocks, backpressure and diagnostics first-class.
